currentParagraphText: “Yes and no. I think the word want is incorrect here, as the Desolate Child of Loss operates nearly entirely on instinct. Most False Gods are born with some prerogative from birth. Either they are made to protect the local tribe or even the planet, or perhaps created to kill a certain enemy. But the Desolate Child of Loss has none of that. This is why I was genuine when I said I wanted to guide him if possible. He needs it more than anyone. Or, well, needed it.”
